mission_layer: Persistent Production Memory + Cinematic Video Intelligence

roadmap_systems.title: Production Memory Manager
roadmap_systems.summary: Persist characters, beats, style, continuity, and iteration outcomes as bounded production memory.

roadmap_systems.title: Scene Graph Builder
roadmap_systems.summary: Map playable scenes, cinematic spaces, and asset relationships into reusable scene context.

roadmap_systems.title: Shot Planner
roadmap_systems.summary: Turn story beats and gameplay triggers into explicit shot plans with framing and pacing.

roadmap_systems.title: Trailer/Cutscene Director
roadmap_systems.summary: Sequence beats, reveals, and gameplay-cinematic transitions into a coherent directing pass.

roadmap_systems.title: Continuity Checker
roadmap_systems.summary: Guard tone, prop, costume, geography, and gameplay state continuity across generations.

roadmap_systems.title: Asset Reuse Tracker
roadmap_systems.summary: Track reusable shots, prompts, edits, and source assets to reduce drift and cost.

roadmap_systems.title: Gameplay Cutscene Trigger System
roadmap_systems.summary: Bind gameplay conditions and state changes to cinematic beat activation points.

roadmap_systems.title: Cinematic Prompt Compiler
roadmap_systems.summary: Compile production memory into structured shot prompts without invoking generation yet.

roadmap_systems.title: Cost-Aware Iteration System
roadmap_systems.summary: Record failed/successful attempts with cost tiers and prioritize bounded iteration loops.

roadmap_systems.title: Second Brain + Obsidian integration
roadmap_systems.summary: Export human-readable cinematic planning notes while keeping machine memory authoritative.

characters.name: BABYLON Runner
continuity_rules: Keep silhouette readable in gameplay and cinematic framing.
Do not contradict currently implemented player abilities.

environments.name: BABYLON Arena Foundation
lighting_rules: Avoid dramatic darkness that obscures gameplay state.

story_beats.title: Wave Start Pressure Beat
story_beats.summary: A short gameplay-adjacent cutscene establishes the next wave as pressure rises before control returns.
continuity_dependencies: Do not imply weapons or enemies not present in the playable build.

camera_language: brief hero inserts between combat beats
lighting: arena practicals over abstract mood lighting
continuity_rules: Cinematics must respect the live gameplay state and known-good BABYLON systems.
Do not invent props, locations, or powers that the current production case study does not support.
Shot-to-shot lighting must preserve player/enemy readability over dramatic stylization.

shot_history.intent: Establish incoming pressure before the next combat loop.

generated_assets.label: Wave reveal planning prompt
reuse_notes: Use as a baseline for countdown-to-wave reveal beats.

failed_generations.prompt_summary: Attempted an overly dark, trailerized reveal that hid gameplay geography.

successful_generations.prompt_summary: Readable arena reveal with light motion and preserved tactical clarity.
notes: Use as the canonical starting point for BABYLON cutscene proofs.

edit_decisions: Keep cutscene inserts short enough that they can hand control back to gameplay cleanly.
Prefer inserts that clarify upcoming threat state instead of abstract montage.
pacing_notes: Pre-combat beats should feel brief and intentional, not like separate non-interactive scenes.
Use a quick rise in framing intensity just before the player regains control.
cost_aware_iteration_notes: Start with low-cost prompt and storyboard iterations before any expensive video generation pass.
Reuse approved prompts and shot language before introducing new stylistic branches.
